Over de functie

is. SRQ168876

Je werkt als Technisch Solution Architect op het snijvlak van business en IT binnen een domein waar digitalisering en complexe logistieke vraagstukken samenkomen. Je bouwt mee aan de digitale ruggengraat achter de treinreis en vertaalt businesswensen naar toekomstbestendige technische oplossingen. Daarbij heb je een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen van complexe oplossingsrichtingen, het verbinden van teams en het bewaken van architectuurkaders. Je opereert in een omgeving waar Agile, DevOps, Continuous Delivery en schaalbare cloudoplossingen centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om richting te geven aan technische keuzes en tegelijkertijd teams te coachen in hun ontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen

Je slaat de brug tussen businessprocessen en IT en werkt actief samen met teams op de werkvloer.
Je ontwerpt samen met lead developers high-level functionele en technische oplossingsrichtingen voor complexe onderdelen.
Je houdt rekening met standaardisatie, schaalbaarheid, herbruikbaarheid, performance, security en beschikbaarheid.
Je adviseert stakeholders zoals Product Owners, de IT lead en de Lead Solution Architect over gekozen oplossingen.
Je neemt regie op de deliverables die nodig zijn voor de technische architectuur, zoals de inrichting van de cloudomgeving binnen en buiten het domein.
Je ontwikkelt in afstemming met andere architecten een toekomstvisie op de positie van softwarecomponenten binnen het bredere applicatielandschap.
Je zorgt dat oplossingsrichtingen in lijn zijn met wet- en regelgeving en architectuurkaders.
Je bepaalt de impact van organisatorische en technische veranderingen op lopende en toekomstige projecten.
Je adviseert en coacht DevOps-teams bij automatiseringsslagen, continue verbetering van werkwijze, softwarekwaliteit en ontwikkelsnelheid.
Je documenteert en controleert opgeleverde architectuur- en engineeringproducten en draagt de doelarchitectuur en architectuur-roadmap uit.

Over jou

Je hebt WO/HBO werk- en denkniveau en beweegt je gemakkelijk tussen strategisch en technisch niveau.
Je doorgrondt business en bedrijfsstrategie en vertaalt die naar passende technische keuzes.
Je communiceert sterk, van boardroom tot engine room.
Je bent coachend richting DevOps-teams en begeleidt hen in hun dagelijkse ontwikkelproces.
Je bent flexibel, nieuwsgierig en staat open voor feedback.
Je leert snel van fouten en ervaringen en past je gemakkelijk aan veranderende omstandigheden aan.
Je deelt actief je kennis en ervaring met anderen en stimuleert anderen om te leren.
Je voelt je prettig in een grote, complexe organisatie die continu in beweging is.

Eisen

Je hebt WO/HBO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 5 jaar recente ervaring in een architectuur- of vergelijkbare rol.
Je hebt kennis van beheer, data- en securityrichtlijnen en requirements engineering.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met architectuurmethoden, technieken, tools en frameworks.
Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met Microsoft Azure en Azure Kubernetes Service.
Je hebt minimaal 4 jaar ervaring met Infrastructure-as-code, met name Terraform.
Je hebt ervaring met Scrum, SAFe, CI/CD en DevOps, zowel in mindset als tooling.
Je hebt ruimschootse ervaring met het inrichten en beheren van CI/CD pipelines, met name in Azure DevOps.
Je hebt ervaring met het implementeren en inrichten van monitoringtools zoals Datadog.
Je hebt kennis van netwerktechnologieën en -infrastructuur, zoals routers, vpn’s, loadbalancers en firewalls.
Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wensen

Je beschikt over certificeringen zoals TOGAF en ArchiMate.
Je beschikt over certificaten van Microsoft Azure en Kubernetes.
Je hebt ervaring binnen het logistieke domein.
Je bent in staat mee te bewegen met verandering en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, ook in relatie tot de komst van genAI.

Je bent sterk in samenwerken en schakelt effectief met verschillende disciplines en stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
Ecotricity, the UK’s first true green energy provider, has a strong internal technology team building solutions across mission-critical platforms. The Senior Engineer will create solutions that use artificial intelligence to solve real business problems, with AWS/Databricks as the core production platform and Claude and Codex supporting the engineering workflow. This is a hands-on role spanning discovery, software delivery and the reliable operation of live services

Responsibilities

Own the design, build, deployment and ongoing operation of production-grade AI-enabled data products on AWS and Databricks.
Work with stakeholders to define the user problem, measurable outcomes, data requirements and a pragmatic technical approach.
Prototype rapidly with Claude, Codex and other approved AI tooling, then turn successful concepts into secure, maintainable software.
Build reliable data pipelines, APIs and back-end services, together with front-end web or app experiences where the product requires them.
Apply strong software engineering practices including code review, automated testing, CI/CD, version control, documentation and infrastructure as code.
Create evaluation, monitoring and observability for data quality, model or LLM behaviour, service reliability, performance and cost.
Protect sensitive data and apply appropriate security, privacy, governance and responsible AI controls throughout the product lifecycle.
Operate and support live services, resolve faults swiftly, reduce technical debt and share practical knowledge with the wider team.

About the team

The Ecotricity Technology department is a small friendly team with a strong focus on getting results, with everyone committed to delivering both individually and as part of the group/project.

We have a training programme in place to further advance your skills, with dedicated learning time planned into our workloads. Relevant training and certifications, including Databricks and AWS, are supported by the company, alongside opportunities to deepen applied AI and software engineering skills.

We’re proud to be an ethical company, and this naturally attracts ethical people, making for a good safe working environment and a team that works and wins together. We also have a competitive benefits package and chose to invest in our people whenever we can.

About You

Are you an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business problems and data into useful, production-ready products? We are looking for a practical Senior Engineer who can take ownership from early discovery and prototyping through to deployment, adoption and support.

You will design and build end-to-end AI-enabled solutions on AWS and Databricks. Depending on the problem, this may pipelines, APIs, backend services and user-facing websites or applications.

We value sound engineering judgement over using AI for its own sake. You will select the simplest effective approach, prove value quickly, and then engineer for security, performance, cost, maintainability and scale. Experience in the energy industry is helpful but not essential.

You will work closely with product owners, project managers, subject-matter experts, data teams and other stakeholders. You will explain options clearly, demonstrate working software, gather feedback and translate it into measurable product outcomes.

This is a hybrid role, you will be self-motivated, delivery-focused and comfortable driving work independently. You will also contribute to shared engineering standards, review the work of peers and actively develop your own skills as AI tooling evolves.

If you want to build responsible AI products that move beyond prototypes and deliver tangible value in a dynamic, purpose-led organisation, we encourage you to apply.

Knowledge And Skills

Experience building and operating production software, data products or applied AI systems.
Strong Python, including experience designing APIs and integrating external services.
Practical experience with Databricks
Experience deploying secure, scalable workloads on AWS.
Understanding of applied AI and LLM patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, structured extraction and evaluation.
Effective use of AI coding assistants such as Claude and Codex, with the judgement to review, test and own the resulting code.
Strong software delivery practices using GitHub or Bitbucket, automated testing and CI/CD.
Ability to build usable front-end web or app experiences using TypeScript, React or a comparable framework.
Clear communication, product thinking and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Advantageous

MLflow, RAG, Vector Search or comparable model and AI application tooling.
Terraform and automated AWS infrastructure delivery.
Container-based deployment, serverless services or modern application observability.
UX or product design experience for internal or customer-facing applications.
Experience of the energy industry or other regulated, data-sensitive environments.

About Us

What's in it for you...

Healthcare plan, life assurance and generous pension contribution

Volunteering Day

Hybrid Working

Various company discounts (including shops, gyms, days out and events)

Holiday of 25 days (plus bank holidays) & ability to buy/sell days

Cycle to work scheme, car pooling and onsite parking available

As a valued member of the team, you will be supporting the Group Environmental Policy and its associated sustainability objectives and targets.

Flexibility Statement

The fast moving nature of the business means that from time to time you may be asked to perform duties or tasks outside of your original job description on an ad hoc basis. This allows the company to utilise our people in the best possible way at all times and helps our colleagues to make the best contribution in a changing environment.

Ecotricity is Britain's overall greenest energy company- it’s more than just green energy – the breadth and depth of our work on green issues is unmatched. When we started back in 1995, we were the first company in the world to provide a new kind of electricity - the green kind.

Our mission was, and remains, to change the way energy is made and used in Britain - by replacing fossil fuels with clean, renewable energy.

We don't just supply green energy, we use the money from our customers' bills to make it ourselves too – we have built windmills and sun parks in Britain. We call this turning 'bills into mills'.

We don't just focus on energy though- we built the Electric Highway, Britain's leading network of electric vehicle charging points; we helped Forest Green Rovers become the greenest football club in the world; and we launched Britain's greenest mobile phone service, Ecotalk, where they use the money from their customers' bills to protect and regenerate Britain's lost rainforests.

Ecotricity is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to providing equality for all.

Proper ownership, a technically demanding product and the chance to work closely with people who know their security.

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota.
